newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Former MP to head Australia Cotton Foundation.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Former MP to head Australia Cotton Foundation.

text.p: Former federal minister Gary Punch has been appointed executive director of the Australian Cotton Foundation (ACF).
ACF chairman Peter Corish said Punch's wide experience in government and his excellent communication skills made him the ideal person to lead the Australian cotton growing industry.
This was particularly so at a time when the industry was facing major technological change and challenges in communicating its achievements and sustainability to the community, he said.

Punch, 39, has a commerce degree from the University of New Souyth Wales and has had careers in local government, federal politics and industrial relations. He is currently finishing a law degree with the University of Technology in Sydney.
Punch's last federal portfolio was as Minister for Defence Science and Personnel between 1994 and 1996.
